name: Star Crossed
source:
What’s better than gays? Space gays! Date cute constellation guys from outer space while trying to help them save the Earth from destruction! 

[From [url=https://rainbowjellie.itch.io/star] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
還有什麼比同性戀更棒？太空同性戀！與來自外太空的可愛星座男子約會，同時幫助他們拯救地球免於毀滅！

（來源：[url=https://rainbowjellie.itch.io/star]itch.io[/url]）
